audience: teams that turn receipts, invoices and scanned contracts into searchable text

useCases.title: Read the text from a receipt or invoice photo
useCases.text: Send the public https link of an image, or a small file as base64. Turn on table mode for receipts and invoices to get the text line by line.

useCases.title: Extract a table from a scanned invoice PDF
useCases.text: Send the public https link of the PDF with table mode on and engine 3. The text comes back line by line, with one entry for each page.

useCases.title: Make a scanned contract searchable
useCases.text: Send the public https link of a scanned image or PDF. Get a link to a searchable PDF with a text layer, valid for one hour, and the recognized text.

useCases.title: Check the OCR languages, engines and usage limits
useCases.text: List the language codes, the three OCR engines and the usage limits. Pick a language and an engine before you send a file.
